trigger_authority.reason: The previously frozen D4 role was a closure-resolution control if D3 left an unresolved resolution/closure question. D3 now shows large regime-dependent redistribution error while preserving equilibrium and the water ledger.

scientific_question: Does adding one fixed storage degree of freedom at 130-140 cm materially reduce the standard-LARE D3 redistribution error, or is the dominant error structural to the published layer-averaged closure?

D3.role: frozen primary state from RS1-GW closeout

unchanged: EQ, WET, DRY and WET_DRY top forcing sequences
iterative-Heun numerical authority and refinement ladder

comparison_basis.D4_to_D3_projection: sum D4 storage in 0-130 and 130-140 before comparison; preserve the two lower 10-cm layers unchanged
comparison_basis.common_case_rule: Compare D4 against D3 only on cases qualified for fine Reference, D3 LARE and D4 LARE. Exclusions are allowed only for frozen domain/numerical status, never because of error magnitude.
metrics: max absolute storage error on common D3 bands
mean absolute storage error on common D3 bands
final signed storage error on common D3 bands

adjudication.RESOLUTION_BENEFIT_CLEAR: D4 is non-inferior to D3 on both max and mean common-band storage error for every common dynamic case and strictly improves both metrics for at least one Se0>=0.85 dynamic case.
adjudication.RESOLUTION_EFFECT_MIXED: D4 improves some common dynamic cases or metrics but worsens others.
adjudication.CLOSURE_LIMIT_DOMINANT: D4 provides no strict improvement in max or mean common-band storage error on any Se0>=0.85 common dynamic case.
adjudication.note: These are closure-resolution research outcomes, not application acceptance thresholds.

next_logic.if_RESOLUTION_BENEFIT_CLEAR: D4 may be retained as a higher-state LARE challenger, but D3 remains the minimum-state authority and coarse-Richards comparison is still required.
next_logic.if_RESOLUTION_EFFECT_MIXED: Do not add further state automatically; inspect where the error is generated before changing state or closure.
next_logic.if_CLOSURE_LIMIT_DOMINANT: Do not escalate state dimension under standard closure; proceed to closure analysis such as equilibrium-aware or other physically justified correction.
